people.name: Asenath
people.line: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: On
people.line: An ancient Egyptian city, mentioned in relation to Joseph

translations.web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
translations.bsb: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
translations.kjv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare
translations.asv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.
